subtitle: Fast product search, filters and sorting you control
introduction: Help shoppers find products faster with instant search, flexible filters and sorting you control.
details: Replace your theme's search with instant results, typo tolerance and synonyms. Add filters by brand, price, size, color, metafields and more to search and collection pages, and choose how products are sorted. Pin, hide or boost products for any search. Prices follow each shopper's market. If the app is ever unavailable, your theme's own results keep showing. Developers get a JavaScript SDK and JSON API for custom sections.
features: Instant search with typo tolerance, synonyms and redirects
Filters for price, brand, options, metafields and availability
Sorting options you can rename, reorder and set per collection
Pin, hide or boost products for specific searches
Prices shown in each shopper's currency and market
Analytics for top and zero-result searches, with one-click fixes
AI search that understands meaning on Pro plans and above

screenshots.alt: Home page with a setup guide, app embed status and search activity for the last 7 days
Search settings with per-field weights and a live search preview
Filter builder listing price, brand, size and color filters with display options
Merchandising rules that pin, hide or boost products for searches and collections
Appearance editor with colors and texts next to a live storefront preview
Analytics with suggested synonyms for searches that returned no results
